sunMethod.measuredAt: the living-room opening, 1.0 m above the floor, under the balcony above
limits: Nearby buildings and hills come from the Lands Department 3D model (about 0.5 m accurate; simplified with distance).
Future buildings are counted only in the withFuture figures.
Measured at the living-room opening, 1.0 m above the floor, with the balcony above as a cover. The balcony's side walls and the window frames are not modelled.
Clear-sky geometry only: cloud and haze are not considered.
Shares of the view in front of the window: 120 degrees wide, from 20 degrees below level to 40 above.
Greenery is read from the colour of the 3D model's photos; water is any surface below 2.5 mPD.
Future buildings are not included.
